description: Reviewable allowlist of package names each governance task may additively introduce into pyproject.toml / requirements.txt. Enforced by validators/dependency_manifest_diff_validator.py. Adding an entry here is itself a reviewable governance change.

GV100H-M2-DEPS.description: PDF ingestion dependencies for gv100h/spec_qa (raw-PDF corpus chunking).

GOVERNANCE-VALIDATOR-INFRA.description: Infrastructure dependencies required by the governance/validator tooling itself (e.g. TOML parsing backport for Python versions the repo declares support for but that lack the stdlib module). Not tied to a single feature task.
